## `cfeval run`

ask the golden set and score it (Local scoring or Foundry Evaluations scoring)

| Argument / Option | Choices | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--option` | `both`, `fabric-native`, `foundry` | `'fabric-native'` | scoring backend: fabric-native (Local scoring), foundry (Foundry Evaluations [experimental]), or both |
| `--mock` | — | `False` | simulated tenant: no sign-in, no network |
| `--profile` | `baseline`, `untuned`, `improving`, `tuned`, `ambiguous` | `'baseline'` | simulated behaviour (with --mock) |
| `--seed` | — | `7` |  |
| `--repeats` | — | — |  |
| `--golden` | — | — | golden set path (.yaml, .json, or .csv) |
| `--questions` | — | — | comma-separated question ids to run (default: all) |
| `--explain` | `followup`, `inline`, `off` | — |  |
| `--no-trace` | — | `False` | skip DAX capture |
| `--no-publish` | — | `False` | local files only, no Eventhouse |
| `--target` | — | — | evaluation target (default: copilot-chat) |
| `--transcript` | — | — | transcript file path when using transcript-import / import |
| `--from-m365-copilot-eval` | — | — | score saved results JSON/JSONL from Microsoft 365 Copilot Evaluations CLI |
| `--gate-profile` | `auto`, `with_engine_evidence`, `without_engine_evidence`, `tool_call_evidence`, `work_iq` | — | gate policy profile |
| `--gates` | — | — | comma-separated gate check override (for example: value,artifact) |
| `--persona` | — | — | persona context override |
| `--shard` | — | — | deterministic question shard 'i/N' (for example: 0/2) |
| `--max-questions` | — | — | maximum questions to ask in this run |
| `--max-judge-calls` | — | — | maximum judge model calls allowed |
| `--max-wall-seconds` | — | — | wall-clock budget in seconds for question collection |
| `--resume` | — | `False` | reuse completed asks in an existing run folder |
| `--run-id` | — | — | explicit run folder identifier (useful with --resume) |
| `--strict` | — | `False` | exit non-zero on errors, critical failures, or low pass rate |
| `--min-pass-rate` | — | `0.8` | minimum pass rate enforced by --strict |
| `--html` | — | — | write self-contained HTML report to path |
| `--otel-out` | — | — | export OpenTelemetry spans JSONL/JSON to path |
| `--expand-paraphrases` | — | `False` | expand question paraphrases into separate asks |
| `--name` | — | — |  |
| `--notes` | — | — |  |

## Exit Codes

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `0` | Success (all enabled quality gates passed) |
| `2` | Quality gate failure (`FAIL` / `partial` outcome) |
| `3` | Runtime, telemetry sink, or incomplete evidence error |
| `64` | CLI usage or configuration error |
